message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to call external services like VirusTotal directly from here. If you’d like to check the IP address yourself, you can use the VirusTotal API with a request similar to this:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/192.168.0.1" \
     -H "x-apikey: KEY123"
```

Make sure you replace `KEY123` with your actual API key. If you run into any issues or need help interpreting the response, feel free to let me know!
